propka_k.status: sign and scale reproduced against one reference; single code path; NOT a measured pH switch
propka_k.what: organisers' tnf_ph_score layer K (PROPKA 3.5.1): k_release at pH 6.0 vs 7.4, positive = acid release; paired variant-minus-parent at the same seed, 5 poses

measured.reference_variant_delta: this scorer on 5 fresh Boltz-2 poses: +0.94 +/- 0.24; another agent's stack on 15 poses: +0.638 +/- 0.124 (about 1.1 combined SE apart)
measured.same_script_same_poses: a second agent's panel re-scored here reproduced its published delta and absolute release to 3 decimals; this checks the environment, not the method
measured.run_to_run_source: 5 variants, two independent Boltz-2 runs of the same sequences and seeds, one agent; binding ipSAE over the same structures moved 8x less (sd 0.034)
measured.unresolved: the absolute release of the inherited pH lead read +0.47 and -0.01 in two own runs against a reported +0.66; one run can move more than the quoted sd

rules_in_use.supported: n_pose >= 5, delta >= 0.5, z >= 2 (same as the ranker)
rules_in_use.proposed_not_adopted: every absolute pose release > 0 and every paired delta > 0 (a mean can hide a pose that binds harder at acid pH); needs all three agents
rules_in_use.parent_baseline: parents below about -1.2 (pH 6.0 vs 7.4, mean) cannot be rescued by a 1-2 His edit worth ~+1.2: do not spend a panel; of 82 long designs only 9 were above -0.5 and 37 were below -2

limits: predicted poses, not measured structures; PROPKA is an empirical pKa model
no independent code path has re-scored these numbers yet
the scorer's own --selfcheck needs a control file that is not shipped; validation here is by reproduction, not by that check
quote any single pH mean with +/- 0.26
